extraction.name: PASTIS
extraction.description: Panoptic Agricultural Satellite TIme Series (PASTIS) is the first large-scale, publicly available satellite image time series dataset with semantic and panoptic annotations for agricultural parcels.
extraction.creator: Vivien Sainte Fare Gamot; Loic Landrieu
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset consists of Sentinel-2 multi-spectral image sequences from four regions of France, with acquisitions automatically filtered for extensive cloud cover, and annotations sourced from the French Land Parcel Identification System.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: The time series are irregular because acquisitions with extensive cloud cover were automatically filtered, and close to 28% of images still have at least partial cloud cover.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Multi-spectral Sentinel-2 satellite image sequences with 10 non-atmospheric spectral bands after atmospheric correction and resampling at 10 meters per pixel.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The Sentinel-2 data were atmospherically corrected and resampled to 10 meters per pixel, and acquisitions with extensive cloud cover were automatically filtered by the data provider.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Each pixel is assigned a semantic label from 18 crop types plus background, and each non-background pixel has a unique parcel instance label; annotations come from the publicly available French Land Parcel Identification System.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The paper reports annotation accuracy estimates from the French Payment Agency: over 98% for crop annotations via in situ control and relative surface error under 0.3%.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The paper states that panoptic segmentation of agricultural parcels has major economic and environmental implications, including fair allocation of agricultural subsidies and ensuring crop rotation practices are respected.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset is highly unbalanced, with a ratio of over 50 between the most and least common classes.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset has irregular acquisition times due to cloud filtering, close to 28% of images still have partial cloud cover, and it covers only four regions of France.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training and evaluating panoptic segmentation models on satellite image time series, and semantic segmentation experiments with 5-fold cross-validation.

name.evidence: Lastly, we present Panoptic Agricultural Satellite TIme-Series (PASTIS), the first open-access dataset for training and evaluating panoptic segmentation models on SITS, with over 2billion annotated pixels covering over 4000 km2.

description.evidence: We present PASTIS (Panoptic Agricultural Satellite TIme Series), the first large-scale, publicly available SITS dataset with both semantic and panoptic annotations.

url.evidence: This dataset, as well as more information about its composition, are publicly available at https://github.com/VSainteuf/pastis-benchmark .
